title: Gold Plus Account: Transferring funds to external banks
summary: This document explains how to transfer funds to external banks from a Gold Plus Account, including that standard external transfers typically complete within 1 business day (after submission time and verification). It states you can transfer out up to $50,000 per day across external transfers, and that transfer fees are waived for this tier. It also outlines the in-app steps: add/verify the external bank, select recipient and amount (up to the daily limit), choose transfer date, review/confirm, and track progress on the transfer activity screen.
